meta.label: ACT TWO
rules: the picture is cut to the stick timeline: its beats are the shots, its lines are the lines, nothing re-timed
a continuation beat that follows its own shot directly merges into it
a line starts on the frame in which its first sound falls (beat start + t; t may be negative, a pre-lap), ends after the frame of its last sound
mouths and words on the same rule; a line appears in every shot it sounds in (carry = runs in from an earlier shot, pre = starts under this one before its own)
marks come from the stick's own sound spots and text, the takes' words, or a base lock's marks scaled to the new length
the framing decides who shows a mouth (face), not the take's lip_sync flag
meta.note: Nothing here was watched or heard. The numbers are measured from the files; whether the picture reads needs a person.

lines.text: Any questions, before we take the picture?
I have one concern.
Is it just the one?
It has sub-concerns. I've grouped them by how worried we should be.
Big smiles, please. Eyes on camera one.
Camera one. Anyone.
We own camera two.
Congratulations on your launch, Mas. Really. Everyone's using it.
thank you.
They ask it the things they used to ask us. And it tells them what a great question it was.
how's the dancing?
We're being thoughtful.
Folks, I just want to say one thing.
Whatever you promise in here today, put it in writing.
mine's half written.
Longer.
it's a good photo.
Don't mind me. It's a thread. One of forty-seven.
which one am i?
Most of them.
You may have had in mind the effect on jobs, which is really my biggest nightmare in the long term.
gtp-4 and other systems like it are good at doing tasks, not jobs.
Is there anything you'd like this committee to do?
i would form a new agency that licenses any effort above a certain scale of capabilities…
Would you come and run it?
i love my current job.
You love it. Do you make a lot of money doing it?
i get paid enough for health insurance.
That proves nothing. Partially.
i have no equity in nopeai.
The next one costs billions. Nobody donates billions.
so they don't donate. they invest.
Capped at what?
a hundred times.
And who's in charge?
the board.
And you?
nothing.
Good answer.
if we can comply, we will, and if we can't, we'll cease operating.
It's one sentence. It doesn't say what it costs.
So I'm adding a footnote. A short one.
we'll read it.
It has an appendix.
Can we help you? This is the extinction table.
The more you buy, the more you save.
